correctness.rationale: A unit-Jacobian difference substitution and diagonal scaling integrate all 2^d d! chambers exactly, yielding volume 2^d/(d+1)!. Dirichlet(1,...,1) second moments yield v_d, and an exact dimension-by-dimension telescoping identity reduces its trace to harmonic numbers. For d=2..18 all 17 rational comparisons R_d^{2d}<1 are reproduced by verify.py; for d>=19 the analytic c_m-4 log m growth from exact m=20 base proves the strict comparison. Harmonic estimates and a controlled logarithm expansion yield asymptotic coefficient 1/4. Exact independent planar polygon checks agree.

value.rationale: The invariant is a natural affine-invariant measure of high-dimensional convex-body geometry on a canonical, nontrivial type-B polytope family. The exact harmonic covariance determines all uniform-volume quadratic geometry. The strict below-crosspolytope relation in every dimension is not implied by containment or the Hanner comparison (the Hanner lower extremum is class-restricted), and the sharp log-squared/d deficit quantifies how the two families coalesce asymptotically. The observation has clear mathematical content in all dimensions rather than an arbitrary small-parameter instance.
